title: Drone-only TFR set up over Picatinny Arsenal before Thanksgiving

tellings.quote: about the situation is that there was a TFR set up over Pikatini Arsenal a month prior like before Thanksgiving

plain: About a month before Thanksgiving 2024, Jake Barber says, a temporary flight restriction, a no-fly order from aviation authorities, was put over Picatinny Arsenal, a US Army base in New Jersey, and it was aimed only at drones. Barber, a guest who says he picked up a UFO with his helicopter, tells it as something he knows directly and points to the timing as a clue that someone knew in advance.
